about: The failing cases of the round-5 restart / two-Studios / Teams hunt (hunt1 cases.tsv, run against real Studios), each with the regression tests that reproduce it. Passing cases C01-C07 and the two measurements (C13, C19) are left out.

cases.setup: Studio A builds an edit of egg-picker (a demo project); Studio B: POST /api/reset
kb's first build killed; the disk is full at the next start; space freed; restart
kb's first build killed; the next start killed after it took over the stopped Studio's journal; restart
kb's first build killed (one try); Ctrl+C during the start-up while it rebuilds, before serving (many projects); restart
the same with a default projects folder
kb's first build Ctrl+C'd; two starts that can't listen (a mistyped --host); a normal start
cases.expected: starts that never served count no try

cases.setup: the terminal window closed (SIGHUP) twice during kb's first build; SIGTERM the same
boom-kb's first build fails (design kept); `morph studio boom-kb`
cases.expected: its design kept; told how to go on

cases.setup: team Studios A and B; a request applied in A; A killed mid-build; B lists, applies, closes
cases.expected: B opens it again and can apply it

cases.setup: a team Studio stopped as the request's revision is written; restart; apply again
cases.expected: the request is applied with that revision

cases.setup: A started on egg-picker, B on so101; B deletes egg-picker
kb built and chatted in A; B deletes kb and makes a new kb
cases.expected: A shows the new kb's own chat

cases.setup: A keeps a failed boom-kb's design; B deletes boom-kb and makes a new one; A: build it again
two Studios start together after a reboot cut kb's first build off
